description: The planner's own planning figures, one copy for the apps: the time on the ground at a stop the pilot gave none for, a 30-minute turnaround (the owner's pick, 2026-10-20), and the altitude an airplane's cruise TAS and fuel burn are taken as its own at on a standard day, 6,000 ft (a row of every handbook's cruise table, FAA-H-8083-25C ch. 11).
